registers.name: ENABLE
registers.description: Global enable control for request issuance, response qualification, and safety-controlled actuator behavior.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: When 1, enables normal control-wrapper operation. When 0, suppresses unsafe request issuance and forces safe fallback behavior.

registers.name: CLEAR_FAULTS
registers.description: Write-one action to clear latched fault, stale, and timeout indicators and return the control wrapper to a clean safe state.

fields.description: Write 1 to clear sticky fault/status indicators. Reads are not required for WO semantics.
